label: Salvecomb
description: One waist-high arched frond per plant, serrated along its windward edge like a comb's teeth, silver-downy where it combs the fog. Grows alone in shade lines. Its down mats wick clean condensate; field dressing is the fiction. Rare enough to be worth a walk under the overhangs.
